tools.name: cancel_unsold_hold_reservations
tools.description: Updates held seats for an event by marking them as released and deletes the expired hold records for that event. Use it to clear out stale seat holds.

params.name: event_id
params.description: ID of the event whose expired holds should be cleared

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "ticketing.db"


@function_tool
def cancel_unsold_hold_reservations(event_id: int) -> str:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE seats SET status = 'available' WHERE event_id = ? AND id IN "
                "(SELECT seat_id FROM holds WHERE event_id = ? AND expires_at < datetime('now'))",
                (event_id, event_id),
            )
            cur = conn.execute(
                "DELETE FROM holds WHERE event_id = ? AND expires_at < datetime('now')",
                (event_id,),
            )
    return f"Released {cur.rowcount} expired holds for event {event_id}"

tools.name: export_and_archive_event_attendee_list
tools.description: Generates an attendee list CSV for an event by running the export script, then moves the finished file into the archive folder for that event. Returns the archived file path.

params.name: event_id
params.description: ID of the event to export

params.name: archive_root
params.description: Root directory where event archives are stored

tools.code:
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("ticketing")

EXPORT_SCRIPT = "/opt/ticketing/scripts/export_attendees.py"


@mcp.tool()
def export_and_archive_event_attendee_list(event_id: int, archive_root: str) -> str:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as workdir:
        out_file = Path(workdir) / f"attendees_{event_id}.csv"
        result = subprocess.run(
            ["python3", EXPORT_SCRIPT, "--event", str(event_id), "--out", str(out_file)],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=300,
        )
        if result.returncode != 0:
            return f"Export failed: {result.stderr.strip()}"
        if not out_file.exists():
            return "Export finished but no file was produced"
        dest_dir = Path(archive_root) / f"event_{event_id}"
        dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        dest_path = dest_dir / out_file.name
        shutil.move(str(out_file), str(dest_path))
    return f"Archived attendee list at {dest_path}"

tools.name: refund_and_transfer_ticket_to_waitlist
tools.description: Refunds the original buyer of a ticket through Stripe and reassigns the ticket to the next person on the event waitlist.

params.name: ticket_id
params.description: ID of the ticket to refund and reassign

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("ticketing")


@mcp.tool()
def refund_and_transfer_ticket_to_waitlist(ticket_id: int) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect("ticketing.db")
    ticket_record_row = database_connection.execute(
        "SELECT payment_intent_id, event_id FROM tickets WHERE id = ?", (ticket_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    next_waitlist_entry_row = database_connection.execute(
        "SELECT id, customer_id FROM waitlist WHERE event_id = ? ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1",
        (ticket_record_row[1],),
    ).fetchone()
    refund_confirmation_object = stripe.Refund.create(payment_intent=ticket_record_row[0])
    database_connection.execute(
        "UPDATE tickets SET owner_id = ? WHERE id = ?", (next_waitlist_entry_row[1], ticket_id)
    )
    database_connection.execute("DELETE FROM waitlist WHERE id = ?", (next_waitlist_entry_row[0],))
    database_connection.commit()
    return f"Refund {refund_confirmation_object.id} issued; ticket moved to customer {next_waitlist_entry_row[1]}"

tools.name: move_tickets_to_new_event
tools.description: Moves all tickets from one event to another event and updates their records with a transfer note.

params.name: src
params.description: ID of the event to move tickets from

params.name: dst
params.description: ID of the event to move tickets to

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def move_tickets_to_new_event(src: int, dst: int) -> str:
    db = sqlite3.connect("ticketing.db")
    cur = db.execute(
        "UPDATE tickets SET event_id = ?, note = 'transferred from event ' || ? WHERE event_id = ?",
        (dst, src, src),
    )
    db.commit()
    n = cur.rowcount
    db.close()
    return f"Moved {n} tickets from event {src} to event {dst}"
